Laura / Marissa — drafted proposed exhibit language attached (pricing_matrix_novaforge_proposed_v1.xlsx). Key points:

- True-up calculation: we propose a clear formula line: Monthly True-up Adjustment = (CommittedBandLow - ActualUsage) / CommittedBandLow * CommittedRate where threshold is 30%. For declines between 10–30% we apply a partial phase-out credit at 0.5x.
- Overages: any usage above the committed high by >30% billed at overage rate = BaseTierRate * 1.15.
- Credit capping: credits offset charges in the same invoice. If credits would otherwise exceed the invoice amount, excess credits roll forward to the next invoice and expire after 6 months. No cash refunds.

I kept the math conservative to avoid immediate revenue leakage; if NovaForge pushes back on the 6-month expiry we can extend but would prefer to preserve predictability.

Marissa — I left two TODO notes where the exhibit language should reference indemnity carveouts and where a pro-rated termination payment may be triggered if committed bands are materially breached.

Attachment: pricing_matrix_novaforge_proposed_v1.xlsx (XLSX)
